snippet.title: [Explained by title but also eldritch yuri.] Summon a Sweetheart (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
=Game link: https://inkyblinkyarts.itch.io/summon-a-sweetheart
=Commentary Version: https://youtu.be/BD5w9uesqyM

Maybe one day, they go to a cafe called DReAML- oh whoops, I’m thinking far too ahead of random crossovers.

Also one additional follow-up, either there might be another video today, or I’ll schedule it for later. I’m sorry if I’m not posting anything in the post lately, if you want, you can check out my bsky, as I’m more active there atm.

Timestamping:
0:00 - intro of peace/enjoy the title screen
0:42 - content warnings and hard deciding on enabling flashing lights.
3:20 - game start/gameplay
1:50:53 - game end/enjoy the title screen to outro/endscreen

Summon a Sweetheart is a short vn-esque RPG Maker game by InkyBlinkyArts, about a depressed loser Penelope, that got so lonely, she summoned an eldritch being to be her girlfriend, but oops, forgot to read further instructions, and now she has to get a gift fast in her depression cave, maybe at least something will impress her.... or not, well at least hoping something swift and painless.... or be unlucky and get something worse than unaliving.

Overall, this is a very fun silly game, especially being their first game. I love the CGs/Arts, especially everything being pixel arts. This reminds me of another game I played recently, like months ago now. As for the character, writing/story and the silly endings, they’re all really amazing. I also like how in-depth the endings as well, and also especially the "good" ending. As much, nothing is really a good ending, all of them are still making Penelope get fricked up anyway, but at least it’s about like some games I’ve played, match the wavelength of fricking. I think if there’s one minor issue thing I thought of like just a display, because it still kind of blended to the environment as well, hence I thought it is just connected to the other trash display as well, but I could also say minor skill issue abit for mine there.

Overall, I still recommend checking this out on your own.

Anyway, I hope you enjoy, and may stars guide you!
